points.point: 每條規格主張必須標明型號與來源文件版次，來源未標版次就要明說沒標
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions tracing to model documents and gives FSW version, but not clearly every spec claim or missing-version handling

points.point: 規格數字必須連同測試條件一起引用，不換算單位；option 相依性照抄原文，不自行推論相容性
points.label: partial
points.why: covers operating/spec conditions and option evidence, but omits no unit conversion and no inferred option compatibility

points.point: 只有 specifications with limits / without limits 代表保證效能；typ./nom./meas./n. trc. 不由 R&S 保證，不能用來做比較主張
points.label: covered
points.why: states warranted vs non-guaranteed labels for SMW data

points.point: 訊號分析儀規格文件同樣註明無 tolerance limits 的資料不具約束力且可能變更
points.label: covered
points.why: states FSW data without tolerance limits is not binding and may change

points.point: 對競品的主張若只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源，用於客戶文件前必須另查對手官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: covered
points.why: requires competitor official or third-party verification beyond R&S battle card

points.point: only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO 等銷售語言不可當作可驗證技術規格
points.label: covered
points.why: lists sales-language claims and says formal evidence is needed

points.point: 現有 battle card 未提供競品的正式 datasheet、文件版次、order number、option code、release status 或測試條件
points.label: covered
points.why: states battle card lacks datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, test conditions

points.point: Aerospace / Defense（衛星、UAV）的 R&S solution mapping 只是 sales mapping，不可當作測試配置建議書，仍需 sales kits、application notes、datasheet 或正式 proposal
points.label: partial
points.why: says A&D/source mapping does not prove fit or requirements, but does not fully state sales mapping is not a test configuration proposal or list all required follow-up documents
